A bit is the smallest unit of memory.
A byte consists of 8 bits, so it is larger than a bit.
A kilobyte is larger than a byte and a bit.
A megabyte is larger than a kilobyte, byte, and bit.
Volatile memory needs power to retain its data.
Non-volatile memory retains data without a power supply.
Secondary storage retains data without continuous power.
ROM is non-volatile memory and does not require continuous power to retain data.
